editorial.blurb: Bigsuda brings together Chinese and Korean cuisines with standout dumplings, vibrant vegetable dishes, and inventive noodle soups that have earned a devoted following in Wicker Park.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the soup dumplings (xiaolongbao) and eggplant dishes—they're consistently praised as must-tries, and the restaurant shines best when you come with a group to share multiple plates family-style.
signatureDishes: Dombe guksu with crispy fried chicken
